issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Device change request to add Device.note 0..* with type Annotation, short text "Device notes and comments", and definition "Descriptive information, usage information or implantation information that is not captured in an existing element."
initial_application: Git-svn commit 58d5d6e279 added Device.note as 0..* string with a note to change it to Annotation when available. Commit 2a253f8ec2, matching the Jira comment's svn revision 5622, changed Device.note to Annotation, aligned the definition with the resolution, and added an example note. Later source refactors preserved the element in source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists device=Device, putting source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml in current build scope. FHIR-7622 supplied the supporting Annotation datatype and note-element rule. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml already contains Device.note with min 0, max *, type Annotation, the requested short text, and the requested definition.
